# The claims of the guide's pitfall lines (G21). `## ID snippet => CODES [@EDITION]`, then the source
# of Main.tz up to the next `## `. The first diagnostic of `tsuzuri check` must have one of CODES, in
# EDITION or in every supported edition; `{word}` is replaced by each word of the snippet. A line of
# guide/card.md or guide/pitfalls.md, as that edition shows it, holds the snippet and every code.
## P01 pair.0 => E0002
def first :: (i64 * i64) -> i64 = \pair -> pair.0

def main :: unit -> i32 = \() -> 0
## P02 x += 1 => E0002
def main :: unit -> i32 = \() ->
    let mut x = 1
    x += 1
    0
## P03 p.x = 1 => E1012 @2026
record P { x: i64 }

def main :: unit -> i32 = \() ->
    let mut p = P { x: 0 }
    p.x = 1
    0
## P04 xs[i] = v => E1012 @2026
def main :: unit -> i32 = \() ->
    let mut xs = [1, 2]
    xs[0] = 5
    0

    p.x = 1
    0

## R01 E1012 => E1012

## R02 E1014 => E1014

    bump r
    0
